title: The second Monday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Week two. The Datsun won't start in the driveway. Wood pushes it to the road alone and it catches on the hill. The strip learns that the drive is the job.

panels.composition: The ranch house driveway, 7 AM, fog in the hemlocks. The Datsun. WOOD at the wheel, key turned, nothing.

image.prompt: an old small Datsun in a gravel driveway among hemlock trees in morning fog, a thin young man at the wheel, nothing happening, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD out, shoulder to the door frame, pushing the Datsun down the gravel toward the road. The pad on the roof.

image.prompt: a thin young man pushing a small old car down a gravel driveway with a drawing pad on its roof, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The road's slope. Wood jumping in. The engine catching, drawn as a jagged puff from the tailpipe.

image.prompt: close on an old car's tailpipe coughing a jagged puff of exhaust as it rolls down a hill, black and white, no words

panels.composition: 101 north. The Datsun going. Wood, to the pad on the seat.

balloons.text: That's the strip. Pushing it till it catches.

image.prompt: a small car on a two-lane coastal highway between spruce walls in fog, seen from behind, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Week two. The drive is the job.
